none: PAS NLM-670F21: Roman Coin: Sestertius of Domitian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Sestertius of Domitian (81-96), mint of Rome issue of 95-96, RIC volume 2 page 205 no. 412. Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: [--]GERM COS XVII[---]. Reverse description: Jupiter seated left holding Victory and sceptre; SC below. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 33.5mm, Weight: 20.95gms, die axis: 6
